title: The S25 family leak record
summary: A retrospective report on the Galaxy S25, S25+ and S25 Ultra leak cycle.

claims.title: Official-looking S25 family renders leaked before launch
claims.summary: Android Authority reported a set of official-looking renders for the Galaxy S25 lineup, covering the base S25, S25+ and S25 Ultra, with familiar designs and rounded Ultra corners.
claims.assessment: The report described leaked renders and attributed the initial material to Android Headlines, with additional renders from Evan Blass. The final launch is separate from the pre-launch report.

sources.provenance: Android Authority described renders for the S25, S25+ and S25 Ultra and named its reporting chain.
